```yaml
name: Kani Verification

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  kani:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Run Kani verification
        run: |
          cargo kani --features kani --target-dir target/kani
```
